payload.title: Promote E011 statistically but retain E006 for deployment
payload.decision: Promote E011 candidate spline4_ridge_equal_s075 as the verified statistical winner at 12.5507562957 RMSE. Do not make E011 the deployment primary until an inference package, exact local-notebook parity, hidden-scale runtime benchmark, and private internet-disabled Kaggle parity pass independently. E006 remains the deployment-ready primary and E004 remains the exact fallback. Do not start H015 specialist routing before the E011 packaging decision is complete.
payload.rationale: A frozen-commit two-thread reproduction produced byte-identical OOF predictions and eleven substantive result tables, all frozen statistical gates and 21 controls passed, and legality and membership audits found no prohibited routing inputs. The earlier complete-looking invocation still lacks a linked process receipt, so only the independently reproduced run is official. Statistical evidence is complete; deployment evidence is not.
payload.revisit_trigger: Revisit deployment status only after the exact E011 package, local notebook, hidden-scale runtime, and private internet-disabled Kaggle outputs are independently verified.
